k:虐.mnemonic: Something with tiger stripes (虍) sits on top of an overturned crate (匚), claws out, and nobody in the yard dares to move without its say. Tyrannize (oppress).

k:遇.mnemonic: On the path (辶) by the rice field (田) you notice a fresh paw print (禸). Then a figure in a hood (冂), carrying a cocoon (厶), comes round the bend and you are face to face. Encounter (meet, interview, treat).

k:棋.mnemonic: A little block cut from a tree (木), and how sweet (甘) it feels to slap it down on the board for the winning move. Chess piece (Japanese chess).
k:棋.hint: Wooden block slapped on the board.

k:犠.mnemonic: For the sake of righteousness (義), the farmer gives up his only cow (牛), the one thing he can least afford to lose. Sacrifice.

k:礎.mnemonic: Before the timber of any tree (木) goes up, one stone (石) is laid, wrapped in a bolt (疋) of cloth for the ceremony. The whole building will rest on it. Cornerstone (foundation stone).

k:祥.mnemonic: On the morning of the festival, a fat white sheep (羊) wanders up to the altar (礻) all by itself. The year is going to be a good one. Auspicious (happiness, blessedness, good omen).

k:抽.mnemonic: Wherefore (由) is that one stalk sticking out of the top of the box? Fingers (扌) pinch it and draw it out to see. Extract (pluck, pull, excel).
k:抽.hint: Pulling the stalk from the box.

k:啓.mnemonic: Strike (攵) the door (戸) until it swings open, and the mouth (口) inside finally tells what it has been keeping back. Disclose (open, say, speak).
k:啓.hint: Knock until the secret is told.

k:披.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) lift back the pelt (皮) thrown over the cart, and the whole market sees what was hidden underneath. Expose (open).

k:磨.mnemonic: A stone (石) wrapped in rough hemp (麻) cloth is rubbed back and forth, back and forth, until the surface shines like a mirror. Grind (polish, scour, improve).

k:醒.mnemonic: He fell asleep beside the wine jar (酉). The cold light of a star (星) on his face brings him round, clear-headed at last. Awake (be disillusioned, sober up).

k:虎.mnemonic: Tiger stripes (虍) on top, and a pair of legs (儿) padding silently along underneath. Stripes that walk can only be one animal. Tiger (drunkard).

k:慢.mnemonic: He lies in a net (罒) hammock all day (日), heartbeat (忄) slow and smug, and also (又) waves a hand at the people working as if they were beneath him. Arrogant (ridicule, laziness).

k:斬.mnemonic: An axe (斤) drops on the car (車) and takes the roof clean off, turning it into a convertible. The car has lost its head. Beheading (kill, murder).

k:帽.mnemonic: Going out bare-headed in the midday sun is a risk (冒), so you wrap a towel (巾) around your head before you leave. Cap (hat, headgear).

k:匹.mnemonic: A crate (匚) with a pair of legs (儿) sticking out of it: the draper is head-first inside, digging for his last length of silk. Roll of cloth (equal, head).

k:祉.mnemonic: Travellers stop (止) at the altar (礻) by the road, where the village leaves food and water for anyone who needs it. Welfare (happiness).
k:祉.hint: Food left at the roadside shrine.

k:嫁.mnemonic: On her wedding day a woman (女) carries her things across the threshold of another family's house (家). Marry into (bride).

k:珠.mnemonic: The king (王) sells all his stocks (株) for one small round thing out of an oyster, white and softly glowing. Pearl (gem, jewel).
k:珠.hint: A fortune for something from an oyster.

k:卵.mnemonic: A divining rod (卜) taps the shell and a stamp (卩) marks it fresh. Crack it and there are two halves side by side, each with a dot of yolk. Egg (ovum, spawn, roe).

k:机.mnemonic: A tree (木) sawn into a small table (几), just big enough for one book and an inkstone. Desk (table).
k:机.hint: Room for a book and ink.

k:励.mnemonic: He is chopping at the rock overhang (厂) with an axe (斤) and tiring fast. The crowd shouts: more power (力), you are nearly through! Encourage (be diligent, inspire).

k:耕.mnemonic: Drag the plow (耒) through the soil (土) one way and then the other, leaving furrows crossed like the frame of a well (井), ready for seed. Till (plow, cultivate).

k:畿.mnemonic: Ride out from the palace gate and count: how many (幾) fields before the city's reach ends? Every rice field (田) you pass still feeds the emperor's table. Suburbs of capital (capital).

k:菌.mnemonic: Grain (禾) stored damp inside a fence (囗) grows a fuzz on top like tiny flowers (艹). It is mould, and something too small to see is spreading. Germ (fungus, bacteria).

k:堅.mnemonic: The retainer (臣) plants himself on his patch of soil (土) with one hand also (又) raised: nobody passes without papers, and there are no exceptions. Strict (hard, solid, tough).

k:熟.mnemonic: A round (丸) pear softens over low flames (灬) until the child (子) can pop it into his mouth (口), sweet all the way through. Mellow (ripen, mature, acquire skill).
k:熟.hint: A pear softened over a low fire.

k:訂.mnemonic: What you say (言) on paper is not complete (了) until the mistakes are crossed out and written again properly. Revise (correct, decide, decision).

k:塞.mnemonic: Pack soil (土) into every gap under the roof (宀) until not a single draught can get in. Close (shut, cover, block).

k:戯.mnemonic: A kitten with tiger stripes (虍) bats at the tassel of a halberd (戈) left leaning on the wall, rolling over and pouncing again. Frolic (play, sport).
